title: Rising Storm
description: This add-on pack adds new aliens to the Alien Evolution mod
body:
![Addon Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c586f82ccba4a121ae97dc2dae3fe3b9c4127b14.png)

This add-on pack adds new aliens to the [Alien Evolution mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/alienevo)

Current list of aliens:
- Terraspin
- Brainstorm
- Wawrzanin (custom alien)
- Crashhopper
- The Worst
- Bullfrag
- and some more in future

Mods required for this addon:

[Alien Evolution](https://modrinth.com/mod/alienevo)
[Aliens Untapped](https://modrinth.com/mod/aliens-untapped)
[Palladium](https://modrinth.com/mod/threetag-palladium)
[KubeJS](https://modrinth.com/mod/kubejs)
[Geckolib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib)
[Rhino](https://modrinth.com/mod/rhino)
[Architectury API](https://modrinth.com/mod/architectury-api)
[Pehkui](https://modrinth.com/mod/pehkui)



This is my first try of making addons, so every bugs you find, give me info and I try as fast as possible fix this!
[Link for channel of my mod in Alien Evo dc server](https://discord.com/channels/1283874639398834307/1505842909742628985)
